_readme: MuseLink site configuration: the ONLY configuration file an installation fills in.
Copy it to muselink.site.json and put the same file in both places: the PC tool dir, and ~/.config/muselink/ on the Muse VM.
The installers generate every per-side file from it:
PC: pc\install\deploy-pc.ps1 writes <tool dir>\muselink.json and <tool dir>\plugin\policy.json
VM: vm/install.sh writes ~/.config/muselink/muselink.env, policy.json and, when publish.enabled, publish.env
Never edit a generated file: change this file and rerun the installer. An existing file that differs is replaced only with -ReplaceConfig (PC) / --replace-config (VM); the old copy is kept.
Rules: keys starting with _ are help text and are dropped; an empty string means 'built-in default'; nothing secret goes in here (keys and tokens stay files; this file names their paths only).

For the agent filling it in: fill 'site' (required), carry over every value of an existing installation, change nothing else unless the user asks. Each _key next to a value says what it is and how to find it. The guide is docs/install.en.md section 2.

site._help: Values both sides need, written once. The installers put each one where each side reads it.
site._pc_host: Required. The PC's tailnet IPv4 address (100.x.y.z). On the PC: tailscale ip -4
site._pc_user: Required. The Windows account Muse logs in as over SSH. On the PC: $env:USERNAME
site._pc_tool_dir: 必填。选一个非系统盘上的目录，格式 <盘符>:\MuseLink；用 Get-Volume 或 Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem 查目标机器的盘，系统盘是 $env:SystemDrive；已有安装就填它现在的位置。
site._pc_python: 在目标 PC 执行 Get-Command python.exe -All 和 python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)"，确认不是商店占位程序后填实际路径；未找到就留空并先安装，不猜路径。
site._pc_bridge_dir: 留空 = <pc_tool_dir>\muse-bridge（新装用这个）。已有安装：在目标 PC 读现行 muselink.json 的 bridge.root，它不是默认位置时才填这个实际路径。

pc._help: Becomes <tool dir>\muselink.json. The values shown are the built-in defaults. Filled from other sections, do not set here: executor.python (site.pc_python), bridge.root (site.pc_bridge_dir), upload.* (publish).

executor._allow_shell: true only while old VM scripts still need executor.sh shell
executor._agent_desktop_exe: 在目标 PC 用 Get-Command agent-desktop -All、npm root -g 和 Get-ChildItem <tool dir>\tools\agent-desktop -Filter agent-desktop*.exe -Recurse 查找；验证 --help 后填实际 exe 路径。已装沿用；未找到先安装再查，留空不猜。
executor._agent_desktop_home: agent-desktop 状态目录，宿主和截图脚本据此设置 AGENT_DESKTOP_HOME。已装：填 agent-desktop status 返回的 state_root。新装：选非系统盘、用户目录之外的路径，格式 <盘符>:\agent-desktop-home；只建父目录，该目录由 agent-desktop 首次运行自己创建（权限才正确）。留空依次取进程、用户、系统级 AGENT_DESKTOP_HOME，最后是 %USERPROFILE%\.agent-desktop。只决定路径，不搬迁状态、不改权限。

pet._display_name: Name shown on the desktop pet
pet._session_url: “会话”钮打开的 https 地址；留空为 https://muse.ai/。要指定某个会话时，在目标机器浏览器打开它，从地址栏复制。
pet._session_browser: 个人值，可留空。没装 Muse 网页应用时用哪个浏览器打开会话：在目标机器查浏览器 exe 的绝对路径（Get-Command chrome.exe，或开始菜单快捷方式的目标）；留空用系统默认浏览器。
pet._session_profile: 个人值，可留空。浏览器档案文件夹名：在目标机器该浏览器的档案里打开 chrome://version（Edge 为 edge://version），取“个人资料路径”最后一段，如 Default、Profile 4；也决定多个档案都装了网页应用时先用哪一个。

mailbox._agent_aliases: Old agent id -> current id, so older letters join the same thread

web_bridge._allowed_origins: 网页 AI 通道接受的来源（公共网站，不是本机地址）。所示即代码默认值；空数组也等于默认值。要增减，按浏览器地址栏的 origin（协议 + 主机）填写。

bridge._agent: Default agent id for muse-call when neither -As nor MUSELINK_AGENT is set
bridge._require_identity: true = muse-call refuses to send unsigned requests

index._path: 在目标 PC 查现行 muselink.json 的 index.path，或在已确认的信箱目录下查 index\threads.sqlite；未生成则留空，运行时随信箱创建。

tailscale._exe_dir: 在目标 PC 用 (Get-Command tailscale.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source 查可执行文件，再用 Split-Path 取目录；未找到就留空并安装或定位，不猜默认目录。
tailscale._device_name: The PC's name in the tailnet (On the PC: tailscale status, first line). The experience library replaces it with <HOST> before anything is shared

redact._literals: Extra private strings removed before anything is shared: real name, e-mail, own domains, account names. The Windows user, computer name, tool dir and mailbox dir are added automatically

public._help: 在公共库实际托管平台查 index.json 的 URL 和仓库标识，分别填 index_url 与 repo；未建立则都留空，分享写本机 outbox。

plugin_policy._help: Becomes <tool dir>\plugin\policy.json (local agent plugin). It can only tighten: consent_seconds 1..1800, muse_priority_seconds 15..3600; tools maps a tool name to 'disabled' or a tier.

vm._help: Becomes ~/.config/muselink/muselink.env. Empty = the built-in default named in the _key. PC_HOST, PC_USER, PC_TOOL_DIR, PC_PYTHON and PC_BRIDGE_DIR come from 'site'. A value may start with ~/ for the agent user's home.
vm._SSH_KEY: 在目标 VM 用 ls -la ~/.ssh 查实际密钥文件，并以 ssh-keygen -lf <公钥文件> 核对；未配置就留空并先建密钥，不猜文件。
vm._SSH_CONFIG: 在目标 VM 用 test -f ~/.ssh/config 和 ssh -G <PC目标> 查现行 SSH 配置；有自定义文件时填实际路径，未找到留空。
vm._KNOWN_HOSTS: 在目标 VM 查 ssh -G <PC目标> 的 userknownhostsfile，并核对已确认的主机指纹；文件未建立则留空并先完成首次连接确认。
vm._HOST_KEY_CHECK: Empty = yes. accept-new only for the very first connection
vm._USE_TUNNEL: Empty = 1: reach the tailnet through the runtime CONNECT proxy (ts-connect.py). 0 = direct
vm._MUX: Empty = 1: reuse one SSH master connection
vm._ML_STATE_DIR: 在目标 VM 查现有钩子包装脚本的 ML_STATE_DIR 或 hooks/state；未找到留空，安装时确认状态目录。
vm._ML_BRIDGE_HOME: 在目标 VM 用 systemctl cat muse-bridge 和现行 muselink.env 查 ML_BRIDGE_HOME；未安装则留空，按安装手册创建并确认。
vm._WAIT_POLL_SEC: One wait call; keep under the tunnel proxy limits. Empty = 25
vm._PROXY_FALLBACK: 在目标 VM 查运行环境提供的代理地址与服务 Environment；确认能在 systemd/cron 中使用才填，不在聊天输出凭据；未提供留空。
vm._MUSELINK_IDENTITY: 1 = releases are authorized by the identity protocol (grants, cards). Empty or 0 = the older RELEASE_APPROVAL gate (publish section). Exported to the bridge service

policy._help: Becomes ~/.config/muselink/policy.json (identity policy, see docs/protocol.en.md section 4). Every key is required; unknown keys are an error (fail closed).
policy._legacy_unsigned: transition = v1 requests are handled as today (tier 'legacy' below); reject = every unsigned non-enroll request is refused. Switch to reject once every agent has enrolled.
policy._delay_window_s: Author's decision 2026-11-12: at most 2 minutes. The loader rejects values above 120 or below 10.
policy._aliases: Extra type name -> a type listed in classes. Retired built-in names are mapped in code and need no entry.

grant_templates._comment: Optional last task: the 'allow and do not ask again' button on ask cards builds a grant from the request with these rules.

publish._help: Only for publishing your own software through the bridge to your own update server (request type publish-release). enabled false = no publish.env is written; an existing one is left alone.
publish._RELEASE_SSH: 启用发版时必填。在目标 VM 查更新服务器的 SSH 配置和 ssh -G <更新目标>，核对实际 user 与 hostname 后填 user@host；未配置留空并停止发版配置。
publish._RELEASE_SSH_KEY: 在目标 VM 查更新目标的 ssh -G 输出 identityfile，验证文件存在后填实际密钥路径；未找到留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_KNOWN_HOSTS: 在目标 VM 查更新目标的 ssh -G 输出 userknownhostsfile，核对主机指纹后填实际文件；未找到留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_WEB_DIR: 启用时必填。在目标更新服务器查看站点服务配置中的实际发布目录，并用 test -d 验证；未找到留空，不猜路径。
publish._RELEASE_TEST_DIR: 在目标更新服务器查现行测试发布目录并验证 test -d；新装先创建并确认再填，未找到留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_STAGE: 在目标更新服务器用 pwd、ls -ld 查实际上传暂存目录并验证权限；同时用于 PC upload.remote_dir，未找到留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_BASE_URL: 启用时必填。在目标更新服务器查站点服务配置和部署记录，实际 HTTP 验证后填公开下载 URL；未找到留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_LATEST_URL: 在目标更新服务器查更新清单路由，HTTP 验证实际 latest.json 地址后填；未发布留空并提示。
publish._RELEASE_ZIP_NAME: Required when enabled. Published zip name; {version} is replaced, e.g. MyApp-V{version}-win-x64.zip
publish._RELEASE_SETUP_NAME: Published installer name, e.g. MyApp-V{version}-Setup.exe. Empty = releases carry no installer
publish._RELEASE_APPROVAL: Used only when vm.MUSELINK_IDENTITY is not 1. popup = one-click card; delay:2 = upload, wait 2 minutes, then publish; none = publish at once (only with signed releases)
publish._RELEASE_APPROVE_LABEL: Card button. Empty = use the current UI language pack
publish._RELEASE_DECLINE_LABEL: Card button. Empty = use the current UI language pack
publish._RELEASE_ALLOWED_DIRS: 在目标 PC 用 Resolve-Path 查用户批准的出包目录；多个目录用 ; 分隔，未指定留空。
publish._UPLOAD_DEST_PC: 在目标 PC 用 ssh -G <上传目标> 查实际 user 与 hostname，验证连通后填 user@host；未配置留空并提示。
publish._UPLOAD_KEY_PC: 在目标 PC 查上传目标 ssh -G 的 identityfile，用 Test-Path 验证；填实际路径（可相对工具目录），未找到留空并提示。

tailnet._help: Tags for the Tailscale policy fragment printed by: python3 vm/site-config.py acl. Paste it into the Tailscale admin console (Access controls) by hand and tag the two machines there.
